Name: Apple Music
Description: Control Apple Music from your Stream Deck.

studio.wenoa.applemusic.now-playing.Name: Now Playing
studio.wenoa.applemusic.now-playing.Tooltip: Shows the cover of the playing track; press to play or pause

studio.wenoa.applemusic.favorite.Name: Favorite
studio.wenoa.applemusic.favorite.Tooltip: Favorites or unfavorites the playing track

studio.wenoa.applemusic.previous-track.Name: Previous Track
studio.wenoa.applemusic.previous-track.Tooltip: Goes back to the previous track

studio.wenoa.applemusic.volume.Name: Volume
studio.wenoa.applemusic.volume.Tooltip: Raises or lowers the volume of Apple Music by a percentage
